tokens.name: viewer
tokens.usage: Surround of the video viewer and the timeline track area. Strictly neutral so it never tints the picture.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Window background and the gaps between panels.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Panels: library, inspector, timeline headers, toolbars.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Secondary buttons, menus, popovers and dialogs. Not for fields; those use field.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for rows, ghost buttons and menu items. Pressed state of raised controls.

tokens.name: field
tokens.usage: Fill of text, number and select fields and of unchecked checkboxes: a recessed well on surface or surface-raised. Text on it is text; placeholders and units are text-tertiary.

tokens.name: groove
tokens.usage: Unfilled part of slider tracks and progress bars, and the off state of a switch.

tokens.name: thumb
tokens.usage: Slider and switch knobs, in both themes. Always carries shadow-thumb so it separates from light surfaces.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between panels, sections and rows, and the resting edge of text, number and select fields (whose field fill and label also mark them).

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Hover edge of fields; resting edge of checkboxes. Holds 3:1 on surface, surface-raised and field in both themes.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on bg, surface, surface-raised and surface-hover.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Labels, property names and inactive tabs on bg, surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: text-tertiary
tokens.usage: Hints, units, placeholders and shortcut keys on bg, surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: text-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled labels and icons only. Below text contrast on purpose; never use for readable content.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one accent, amber: primary button fill, checked boxes and switches, slider fill, active tab underline, highlighted menu item, inspector keyframes. Bright amber in the dark theme, a deeper orange in the light theme so it still holds 3:1 as a mark on light surfaces. Pair with on-accent.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill of accent controls. Pair with on-accent.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent and accent-hover fills: near-black on the bright amber of the dark theme, white on the deeper orange of the light theme. Never assume it is white.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Accent-coloured text and icons on bg, surface and surface-raised: links, active tool icon, animated-property keyframe outline.

tokens.name: accent-subtle
tokens.usage: Tinted fill behind a selected row or an active toggle, and the halo around a focused field or a hovered slider knob. Text on it stays text or accent-text.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring, 2px solid, offset 1px. Holds 3:1 on every surface.

tokens.name: selection
tokens.usage: Selection outline and keyframe diamonds drawn on timeline clips and on the viewer picture. The same bright amber in both themes, because clips and footage are dark-to-mid in either theme. Always edged with selection-edge.

tokens.name: selection-edge
tokens.usage: 1px line inside a selection outline and around a keyframe diamond or overlay handle, so the amber separates from any clip colour, thumbnail or footage behind it.

tokens.name: playhead
tokens.usage: Playhead line and handle on the timeline and on scrub bars. Highest contrast mark in the app; nothing else uses it.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Error text and icons on bg, surface and surface-raised; destructive menu items; clipping in meters. Always with a word or an icon.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning text and icons on bg, surface and surface-raised: offline media, dropped frames, missing packs. Yellow, to stay apart from the amber accent; because the two are neighbours it must always come with a warning icon and a word.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success text and icons on bg, surface and surface-raised: saved, export finished. Sits toward blue so it is not confused with danger. Always with a word or an icon.

tokens.name: clip-video
tokens.usage: Fill of video and image clips on the timeline. Label in on-clip.

tokens.name: clip-audio
tokens.usage: Fill of audio clips and waveform backgrounds. Label in on-clip.

tokens.name: clip-text
tokens.usage: Fill of text and caption clips. Label in on-clip.

tokens.name: clip-effect
tokens.usage: Fill of effect and adjustment-layer clips. Label in on-clip.

tokens.name: on-clip
tokens.usage: Clip names, icons, waveforms and thumbnails' overlays on any clip fill.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Dimmed layer behind dialogs.

families.sans: "Geist Variable", "Geist", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI", sans-serif
families.mono: "Geist Mono Variable", "Geist Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", "Cascadia Mono", Consolas, monospace

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Track headers, badges, units, section labels.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Property labels, menu shortcuts, clip names, tooltips.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Drag media here to start a project
styles.usage: Default text: buttons, menus, fields, lists.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Inspector section titles, selected tab, dialog button emphasis.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Home screen and store section headings.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Home screen title and empty states. At most one per screen.

styles.name: timecode
styles.usage: Timecodes, frame counts, ruler labels, numeric fields. Always tabular.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between an icon and its badge; gap between timeline clips.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap inside a control: icon to label, items in a segmented control.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Vertical gap between property rows.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Horizontal padding of controls; gap between controls in a toolbar.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Panel padding; gap between inspector sections' rows and their title.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Dialog padding; gap between inspector sections.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Gap between groups in dialogs and on the home screen.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Page margins on the home screen and the store.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Timeline clips, menu items, badges, checkboxes, thumbnails.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, fields, segmented controls, tooltips.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, dialogs, cards on the home screen and the store.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Slider tracks and thumbs, toggle switches, progress bars.

tokens.name: shadow-popover
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, tooltips and dragged items. The 1px ring replaces a border.

tokens.name: shadow-dialog
tokens.usage: Dialogs and the command palette.

tokens.name: shadow-thumb
tokens.usage: Slider and switch knobs only.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Height of compact controls inside the inspector and track headers.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Default height of buttons, fields and menu items.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Height of primary dialog buttons and home-screen controls.

tokens.name: toolbar
tokens.usage: Height of toolbars and panel title bars.

tokens.name: icon
tokens.usage: Icon box. Icons are drawn on a 16px grid with a 1.5px stroke.

tokens.name: track-video
tokens.usage: Default height of video tracks: clip name, a filmstrip of thumbnails, and a slim audio strip.

tokens.name: track-audio
tokens.usage: Default height of audio tracks. Tall enough for a readable waveform under the clip name.

tokens.name: track-aux
tokens.usage: Default height of text, caption and effect tracks.
